courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋
related.transfer: 可遷移「預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑」與「ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Seismic load path in precast structures" and "ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Precast prestressed double-tee roofs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以等同現澆與接合式兩種策略、混合預力接頭、套筒續接與支承長度，讓預鑄構架在地震中可靠傳力並能自行復位；預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋則以以斷面性質、預力反拱、缺口梁端、翼板連接器與吊裝連接完成度，確保雙 T 梁屋蓋從工廠到使用期間都可靠為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on emulative and jointed strategies, hybrid post-tensioned joints, grouted sleeves and seating length that let precast frames transfer seismic force reliably and recentre; Precast prestressed double-tee roofs centres on section properties, prestress camber, dapped ends, flange connectors and completed erection connections that keep double-tee roofs reliable from plant to service, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓板隔板接合器」與「雙 T 梁斷面」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到預鑄預力雙 T 梁屋蓋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「預力放鬆檢查與出廠品質」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diaphragm connectors” and “Double-tee section”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Precast prestressed double-tee roofs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Transfer checks and plant quality control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
history.text: 1994 年 Northridge 地震中多座預鑄停車結構倒塌，凸顯預鑄接頭與隔板傳力的弱點。美日合作的 PRESSS 研究計畫在 1990 年代發展接合式預鑄系統，1999 年於加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成約 60% 縮尺的五層預鑄試驗建築，驗證混合構架與接合式剪力牆的自復位行為；舊金山 The Paramount 公寓以預鑄預力構架在約 2001 至 2002 年完工，完工時被稱為該地震分區最高的混凝土構架建築。2011 年基督城地震中預鑄樓梯崩落，促使各國重新檢討預鑄構件的變位相容。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Several precast parking structures collapsed in the 1994 Northridge earthquake, exposing weaknesses in precast connections and diaphragm load paths. The US–Japan PRESSS research programme developed jointed precast systems in the 1990s and in 1999 completed a five-storey precast test building at about 60% scale at the University of California, San Diego, demonstrating self-centring of hybrid frames and jointed shear walls; The Paramount apartment tower in San Francisco, built with precast prestressed frames, was completed around 2001 to 2002 and was then described as the tallest concrete-framed structure in its seismic zone. Precast stair collapses in the 2011 Christchurch earthquake prompted renewed review of deformation compatibility for precast elements. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
